title: Controlled-substance prescriptions are dated as of, and signed on, the day when issued
rule_summary: Under 21 CFR 1306.05(a) all prescriptions for controlled substances shall be dated as of, and signed on, the day when issued and shall bear the full name and address of the patient, the drug name, strength, dosage form, quantity prescribed, directions for use, and the name, address and registration number of the practitioner.
exam_relevance: Tests that a controlled-substance prescription is dated as of, and signed on, the day it is issued, and the elements it must bear.
common_confusions: A prescription bearing a date later than the day on which it is issued and signed is not dated as of the day when issued.
verification_notes: Read in the current eCFR text of 21 CFR 1306.05 on 2026-09-14.
